name: Passive Reconnaissance
description: Ability to gather network intelligence without directly interacting with target systems. Covers OSINT techniques for network infrastructure discovery, DNS record enumeration, certificate transparency logs, BGP/ASN analysis, and passive traffic analysis where applicable.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to passive reconnaissance techniques

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the distinction between active and passive reconnaissance and why passive techniques reduce detection risk
evidence: Can explain the difference between passive and active reconnaissance
Knows common OSINT sources for network information (WHOIS, DNS, Shodan)
Understands the operational security benefits of passive techniques

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Uses standard passive recon tools under supervision to collect network intelligence
evidence: Queries WHOIS, DNS records, and certificate transparency logs
Uses Shodan, Censys, or similar services to identify exposed assets
Documents findings with proper source attribution under review
Follows engagement scope boundaries during passive collection

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently conducts comprehensive passive reconnaissance campaigns and integrates findings into engagement planning
evidence: Builds complete network profiles from passive sources alone
Correlates data across multiple OSINT sources to map infrastructure
Identifies attack surface elements not visible through active scanning
Produces actionable intelligence summaries for the engagement team

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Develops advanced passive collection workflows; automates OSINT pipelines; mentors others
evidence: Automates passive recon workflows using scripting and APIs
Performs BGP/ASN analysis and network topology inference from public data
Develops recon runbooks for different engagement types
Reviews and mentors junior staff on OSINT methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines the lab's passive recon methodology; develops novel collection techniques; trains teams
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's passive reconnaissance framework
Developed novel OSINT collection or correlation techniques
Published research on passive network intelligence gathering
Trains teams on passive recon strategy and tradecraft

assessment_methods.description: Given a target organization name, produce a comprehensive network profile using only passive techniques within a time limit
Review OSINT collection reports from recent engagements for completeness and source quality
